label: GO step after a rewarded trial when the agent is choosing a2; strongest on the first reward after a loss
explanation: Fires only at GO (never at D1 or D2), and only when the reward input just seen at D1 was 1 (99.9% of mass) and the agent goes on to choose a2 (model_act == 2: 97% of mass; choice logit strongly negative). The predicate GO & prev_reward==1 & model_act==2 gets mass recall ~0.97 but precision only ~0.38, because the feature is silent on many such steps. Magnitude follows how recent the reward streak is: the top activations (~1.0) are the first rewarded trial after an unrewarded one, and in the example windows activation falls off over consecutive rewarded a2 trials (1.0 -> 0.37 -> 0.15 -> 0.06). Requiring the trial two back to be unrewarded or outside the window raised dev F1 to 0.59 (precision 0.50, mass recall 0.87). The feature also fades late in the episode (almost silent after trial 85) and is highest in the upper-middle value bin. It does not fire after unrewarded trials, on a1 choices (3% of mass), or on non-GO steps. Uses only observed inputs and the agent own choice; no future variables.
